exact: negative regulation of TNF-mediated signaling pathway
negative regulation of tumor necrosis factor-mediated signalling pathway

definition: Any process that decreases the rate or extent of the tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway. The tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway is the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of tumor necrosis factor binding to a cell surface receptor.
label: negative regulation of tumor necrosis factor-mediated signaling pathway
